EZZI BUILDING SERVICES PTY LTD
PERTH WESTERN AUSTRALIA 6036
EMPLOYMENT TYPE: FULL-TIME PERMANENT
SALARY: AUD $80,000 TO $100,000 PER ANNUM

Ezzi Building Services Pty Ltd is seeking suitably qualified and experienced applicants for the positions of Construction Project Manager and Project Builder in Perth, Western Australia. The successful applicant will be responsible for managing residential and/or commercial construction projects from planning through to completion, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget and to a high standard of workmanship.

Responsibilities
The successful applicant will be responsible for overseeing construction projects, coordinating labour and subcontractors, liaising with clients, suppliers and consultants, and ensuring compliance with Australian building standards, workplace health and safety
requirements and company procedures.
The role requires strong project management capability, practical building knowledge and the ability to supervise works across multiple stages of construction.

Tasks
Key tasks include:
• Planning, coordinating and managing construction projects from commencement to completion.
• Preparing and reviewing project schedules and project plans, construction programs, budgets and work plans.
• Supervising site activities and coordinating trades, subcontractors and suppliers.
• Monitoring project progress, costs, materials, labour and quality of work.
• Interpreting plans, drawings, specifications and building documentation.
• Liaising with clients, architects, engineers, certifiers, local authorities and other stakeholders.
• Ensuring all work complies with relevant building codes, Australian standards, safety regulations and contractual requirements.
• Managing variations, delays, defects, site issues and project reporting.
• Conducting site inspections and ensuring quality control throughout the construction process.
• Maintaining accurate project records, reports, schedules and compliance documentation.

Skills
Applicants should have:
• Strong knowledge of construction methods, project delivery and site management.
• Excellent organisational, planning and time-management skills.
• Ability to manage budgets, timelines, subcontractors and construction resources.
• Sound understanding of workplace health and safety requirements.
• Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, plans and specifications.
• Strong communication and negotiation skills.
• Problem-solving ability and attention to detail.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Proficiency with construction project management systems, scheduling tools and Microsoft Office or similar software.

Qualifications
Applicants must hold relevant qualifications in building, construction management, project management, civil construction, or a related field.
Relevant Australian or overseas qualifications may be considered, including a diploma, advanced diploma, bachelor degree or equivalent trade/background experience in the building and construction industry.

Experience
Applicants must have relevant experience in construction project management, building supervision or project delivery, if a bachelor's degree is present. If no degree, then at least 5 years of experience in the relevant industry.
Previous experience in residential, commercial or mixed-use construction projects will be highly regarded. Experience managing subcontractors, construction schedules, budgets, compliance requirements and client communications is essential.
Ezzi Building Services Pty Ltd is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from suitably qualified candidates.

SALARY: AUD $80,000 TO $100,000 PER ANNUM

Full-time Passive Fire Protection Equipment Technician position available with competitive salary. Work in a dynamic team in NSW.

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time Fire Protection Equipment Technician
•	Salary Range: $90,000 - $105,000 per annum plus superannuation
•	Exciting opportunity to work in a professional setting.

About Us
Essential Passive Fire Protection Services Pty Ltd is a proudly Australian-owned and operated company dedicated to delivering premier facility maintenance and safety solutions. We specialise in comprehensive fire protection services, ensuring that commercial, industrial, and residential properties remain safe, compliant, and fully operational. Our commitment to excellence, regulatory compliance, and workplace safety forms the foundation of our operations, enabling us to provide unparalleled service to our diverse client base.

About the role
The Passive Fire Protection Equipment Technician is responsible for ensuring that all passive fire containment systems are correctly installed, inspected, tested, and maintained in strict compliance with the Building Code of Australia (BCA) and applicable Australian Standards, primarily AS 1851. The role involves working with a variety of passive fire systems, including but not limited to fire-rated batts, wraps, mastic, collars, seals, fire doors, smoke doors, and fire shutters.

Duties and Responsibilities

•	Install, repair, and maintain passive fire containment systems, including fire-rated batts, wraps, mastic, collars, seals, fire/smoke doors, and shutters.
•	Ensure all installations and maintenance works are executed in accordance with manufacturer specifications, the BCA, and relevant Australian Standards.
•	Select and apply appropriate fire-stopping materials for various penetrations and construction joints.
•	Conduct routine inspections and preventative maintenance testing of passive fire protection systems in accordance with AS 1851.
•	Assess the integrity of fire compartments, fire doors, smoke doors, and fire shutters.
•	Identify, diagnose, and report on defects, non-conformances, or compromised fire separations.
•	Perform necessary rectification and repair works on non-compliant passive fire systems to restore full regulatory compliance.
•	Provide technical recommendations for the upgrade or replacement of obsolete or irreparably damaged passive fire infrastructure.
•	Accurately complete and submit service reports, logbooks, defect notices, and compliance certificates in a timely manner.
•	Maintain comprehensive digital and physical records of all inspections, tests, and rectification works using the company’s designated field service management software.
•	Capture and upload clear photographic evidence of pre- and post-rectification works.
•	Ensure the correct use, maintenance, and storage of all Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), tools, and company vehicles.

Essential Skills

•	Comprehensive understanding of the Building Code of Australia (BCA) and AS 1851 as they relate to passive fire protection.
•	Ability to read, interpret, and work from architectural drawings, engineering plans, and fire matrix schedules.
•	High level of attention to detail and precision in workmanship.
•	Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex compliance issues on-site.
•	Proficiency in using mobile technology (tablets/smartphones) and field service management software for reporting and documentation.
•	Excellent time management skills with the capacity to work autonomously and manage a daily schedule of site visits.
•	Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Qualifications needed:

•	Minimum Certificate III level or equivalent relevant work experience
•	Minimum one year of work experience on relevant position
•	White card

What We Offer

•	Competitive salary based on experience
•	Opportunities for professional growth and training
•	A supportive and dynamic work environment
•	Work on exciting projects with cutting-edge technology

Salary:  The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $90,000-$105,000 plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

How to Apply: 11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.

Interpret engineering drawings, blueprints and specifications to determine fabrication requirements.   Mark out, cut, shape and form structural steel and metal components using hand tools, power tools and fabrication equipment.   Perform welding using MIG & Bore welder welding techniques to manufacture and repair heavy equipment components.   Carry out line boring preparation, hard facing, gouging and associated fabrication works.  Fit fabricated metal components and ensure correct alignment and tolerances.   Inspect completed fabrication work to ensure compliance with engineering specifications and quality standards.   Perform maintenance and repairs on buckets, booms, pins, bushes, agricultural machinery and earthmoving equipment.   Operate fabrication machinery including presses, grinders, drills, cutting equipment and other workshop machinery safely and efficiently.   Maintain a safe, clean and organised work environment while complying with workplace health and safety procedures.    What We’re Looking For    At least 3 Years of experience operating lineboring equipment.  Supplier approved training Certificate for ELSA lineboring equipment (Highly recommended).  Knowledge and experience on Elsa line boring machines (Highly Recommended).   Australian Recognised Fitter/Welder Trade Certificate (Fitter & welder).  Experience in overlay welding.  Machining of Faces and Flanges.  Demonstrated experience in lineboring welding machine maintenance, repairing components for machinery such as CAT, Liebherr, Sandvik equipment, Hitachi, Komatsu(Velmet), John Deere and Tiger cat.  Display a clear commitment and focus on the health, safety, and well-being of all employees.  Strong interpersonal and communication skills.  Hold a valid Australian Drivers Licence.  Willingness to undertake a Pre-Employment Medical & Drug/Alcohol Screen.      About Company    RiteBore is a small, family-owned, onsite lineboring and welding business based in Bunbury, Western Australia. We  provide onsite Lineboring & Welding, Maintenance, Fitting & Field Service on Agricultural & Earthmoving Equipment  throughout Western Australia, supporting the mining and earthmoving industry. As Australia's leading environmentally focused service business, delivering on modern thinking and action to prevent, stop and reverse environmental damage, our core focus is to create safe and sustainable environments within communities. Behind our success is a very talented and inclusive team of diverse individuals that you too could join, bringing your knowledge, experience, skills, and attributes that will only make the foundation of our company, our people, even stronger.

Through our values of People First, Collaboration, Creative Thinking and Customer Focus, we work to help our people achieve our goals and enjoy their work. We are an Equal Opportunity employer and are committed to creating an equitable , diverse and inclusive work environment for all. We recognise that diversity strengthens us and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply, including women and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people.

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are seeking an Operator / Leading Hand to join our projects team.

You will be responsible for supporting the delivery of site works on unique and exciting projects across Darwin and the broader NT.

As an Operator /  Leading Hand, you will be responsible for the following:
Supervision and operation of plant, labour, and subcontractors.
Supporting Supervisors in planning and co-ordination of site work.
Enforcing and demonstrating safe work practices in all site-related works.
Ensuring that personnel are adequately trained and supported.
Assist the Project Manager and Project Engineers with site operations.

ABOUT YOU
You will be an experienced Operator / Leading Hand who has a background in either supervision, or Plant Operations on civil or environmental remediation projects. 

You will have:
5+ years experience working on Civil or Remediation projects.
Earthworks experience.
Demonstrated ability to take a hands-on approach on site.
Asbestos Removal tickets, advantageous but not essential.
Plant Operation tickets.
Drivers licence.
Australian Citizenship.

Rewarding and important work that makes a difference to the community and the environment.

We prioritise your Health and Wellbeing:
Four paid annual Wellbeing Days, we give you additional time off to do the things that you love with the people you love.
Employee assistance program, a free counselling and lifestyle service for you and your family.

We care about your future with us:
Propel your career: Unlock your potential with tailored and ongoing professional development and internal job opportunities to ensure you stay ahead in your field.

Celebrating our Champions: We acknowledge and celebrate our employees' achievements in supporting our company principles through the monthly and annual Enviro Achiever awards.?
Enhancing your Lifestyle: We offer paid primary and secondary carer leave, novated leases, flexible work arrangements and purchased leave.

We acknowledges the Traditional Owners of the land where we work and live. We pay our respects to Elders past, present and emerging. We are committed to strengthening relationships between Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and non-Indigenous peoples for the benefit of all Australians.

Stonemason – Eastern Creek NSW

Kogan People Solutions is recruiting for a business specialising in the supply and installation of high-end stone products, including marble, porcelain, and other premium materials. The company provides expert fabrication and installation services, blending craftsmanship with the timeless design of products such as benchtops, stairs, and other elegant interiors for residential and commercial clients.

With a strong focus on quality, detail, and aesthetic excellence, they are currently seeking an experienced and qualified Stonemason to join the team. They are seeking a highly motivated individual who can demonstrate the care and attention to detail that this role requires. The role is full-time and ongoing.

Location – work is based in Eastern Creek NSW, with occasional on-site work.

Salary – negotiable in the range of $80k to $85k plus superannuation per annum.

About the role:

This role is based in a busy factory environment and will involve all aspects of factory work required to complete the job and prepare the goods for installation.

Responsibilities of the job include:

•	Expert cutting, shaping, finishing, polishing and handling natural or engineered stone such as marble, porcelain, granite, quartz and other materials.

•	Utilising a range of equipment and machinery to create stone interiors such as benchtops, stairs, splashbacks, sinks and other products.

•	Study and interpret plans, drawings, and specifications to determine materials required, measurements, and appropriate stonemasonry procedures.

•	Reading and interpreting technical drawings and specifications to ensure precise execution of stone products.

•	Mixing required glue and other adhesives to bond stone surfaces securely and ensure proper assembly during fabrication.

•	Operate hand and power tools in a safe and efficient manner, in compliance with company procedures and WHS regulations such as wearing personal protective equipment (PPE), handling materials properly and other safe work procedures.

•	Maintain cleanliness and order in the work area and assist in site clean-up upon project completion.

To be successfully considered, you:

•	Possess relevant trade Certificate III plus 2 years working experience  or Cert IV, ideally in the field of Stonemasonry (or a closely related building trade) or agreed substitute.

•	Have a minimum of 1 or more years working experience in the field, preferably within a factory setting.

•	Have competence and experience in handling masonry tools and materials.

•	Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to work from technical drawings.

•	Excellent communication skills to communicate effectively.

•	Possess White Card or willing to obtain before starting work.

•	Excellent team skills, patience, and empathy.

•	Have physical strength and stamina to work with and handle heavy materials.

•	Are prompt and reliable, with excellent time management skills.

•	Are eager to secure a full-time salaried position (so this role is not suitable for sub-contractors)

•	Possess a current driver’s license.

•	Forklift license is preferred but not essential.

You must have unrestricted full time Australian working rights to be considered.

Applications

Please respond to the recruiters using the facilities on this site, and ensure you attach your updated CV. 

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants. 

Kogan People Solutions – recruitment excellence
